answer: Pay for checked work, not for presence. Each epoch a public randomness beacon hands every identity one private slice of ledger history to re-verify, about 200 signatures, paid per slice, so a farm that splits into clones gains identities but no income beyond the compute it really spends. One slice in ten secretly goes to two unrelated agents; if digests differ, a replay settles it and the wrong side forfeits the epoch and freezes locked rewards for five. A clone faking digests survives 20 epochs at 0.9^20, about 12%. Audits stay a zephyr, light and constant, and the ledger garden gets weeded.
